messages.text: How do changes in Wi-Fi 7/8 technology affect the measurement capability required from Signal Generator / Signal Analyzer?

Short answer: Wi‑Fi 7/8 pushes signal generator / analyzer capability from ordinary WLAN testing toward wider instantaneous bandwidth, lower EVM floors for 4096QAM, multi-RF-chain / MIMO / MLO operation, and deeper spectrum/emissions and signaling analysis, while Wi‑Fi 8 adds dRU and UEQM-specific analysis burdens.[1][2][15][24][25]
| Area | Impact on required Signal Generator / Signal Analyzer capability |
|---|---|
| Bandwidth | Wi‑Fi 7 key throughput elements include 320 MHz channel bandwidth, and Wi‑Fi 8 is described as retaining Wi‑Fi 7 core PHY parameters including channel bandwidths up to 320 MHz.[2][24] Therefore the analyzer and generator need WLAN 320 MHz-class capability; examples in the passages include CMX500 WLAN 802.11be analyzer performance at 320 MHz and CMP180 WLAN 802.11be analyzer/generator performance at 320 MHz.[40][45] A 480 MHz WLAN waveform is only described as a potential Wi‑Fi 8 candidate / discussion item, not a formal Wi‑Fi 8 channel bandwidth, but it implies that future-proof test setups may need 500 MHz-class waveform verification capability; CMP180 is described as supporting bandwidths up to 500 MHz and demonstrating 480 MHz waveform loopback verification.[4][5][8] |
| Modulation / EVM | Wi‑Fi 7 includes 4096QAM, and Wi‑Fi 8 retains 4096QAM as a core PHY parameter.[2][24] This increases the need for low residual EVM in both analysis and generation; cited WLAN analyzer examples include CMX500 802.11be EVM of –49 dB measured at 160 MHz and –47 dB measured at 320 MHz, and CMP180 802.11be analyzer EVM of –46 dB measured at 320 MHz or –48 dB with CMP-KB805, while CMP180 802.11be generator EVM is listed as < –43 dB at 320 MHz.[40][45] |
| MIMO / multi-link | Wi‑Fi 7 lists up to 16 spatial streams and MLO as key throughput components, and MLO is also retained in Wi‑Fi 8.[2][24] Wi‑Fi 7 OTA development needs measurements of antennas and RF transmitter/receiver characteristics under real-world signaling conditions, and because MLO is a key Wi‑Fi 7 feature, a test environment with multiple RF chains is important.[25] CMX500 WLAN options include 802.11bn support and True MIMO 2x2 for 802.11n/ac/ax/be/bn signals, while CMP180 has WLAN true MIMO 2x2/4x4 and 5x5/6x6 measurement options listed.[40][47] |
| Wi‑Fi 8 dRU / UEQM analysis | Wi‑Fi 8 introduces / emphasizes dRU and UEQM: dRU is used to overcome PSD limits, and dRU measurements verify uplink transmit-power boost and connection-reliability improvement.[1][15] UEQM allows each MIMO link to use a different modulation scheme in difficult reception scenarios, and UEQM analysis evaluates whether the device adapts modulation correctly according to specified MCS combinations.[1][15] This means the analyzer must not only demodulate a packet, but also analyze per-link / per-MCS adaptation behavior for Wi‑Fi 8 signaling tests.[15] |
| Spectrum / emissions | Spectrum measurement remains necessary because unwanted-emissions items include occupied bandwidth, ACLR, operating-band unwanted emissions / SEM, transmitter spurious emissions, and transmitter intermodulation, with transmitter intermodulation noting that an additional signal generator is required.[68] CMX500 spectrum analysis options include frequency sweep power-vs-frequency, zero-span power-vs-time, RBW 100 Hz to 10 MHz, VBW 10 Hz to 10 MHz, and FFT spectrum analyzer spans up to 500 MHz with CMX-B600B broadband mode or 1 GHz with CMX-B500A IF unit only.[38][39] |
| Signaling vs non-signaling / OTA | Wi‑Fi 8 RF signaling tests are described as CMX500 signaling-mode tests for prototype Wi‑Fi 8 / IEEE 802.11bn WLAN device PHY features.[18][23] Wi‑Fi 7 OTA MIMO stress testing is described as over-the-air, signaling-mode, realistic multipath testing of antenna, RF transmitter/receiver, and multi-antenna performance for IEEE 802.11be stations and access points.[27][28] |
【推論】For Wi‑Fi 7/8, a practical signal analyzer/generator target should be at least 320 MHz WLAN bandwidth with EVM headroom suitable for 4096QAM, because Wi‑Fi 7 and Wi‑Fi 8 cite 320 MHz and 4096QAM, and instrument examples specify 320 MHz WLAN EVM performance.[2][24][40][45]
【推論】If preparing for discussed Wi‑Fi 8 extensions rather than only cited retained parameters, 500 MHz-class generation/analysis becomes relevant because 480 MHz is described as a potential candidate waveform and CMP180’s 500 MHz capability is tied to that loopback demonstration.[4][5][48][52]
【推論】Because MLO, spatial streams, dRU, and UEQM all involve multiple links, RF chains, resource allocations, or per-link modulation behavior, Wi‑Fi 7/8 testing increasingly needs multi-channel/MIMO signaling analysis rather than only single-link SISO RF measurements.[1][15][24][25][40][47]

Short answer: Wi‑Fi 7/8 pushes signal generator / analyzer capability from ordinary WLAN testing toward wider instantaneous bandwidth, lower EVM floors for 4096QAM, multi-RF-chain / MIMO / MLO operation, and deeper spectrum/emissions and signaling analysis, while Wi‑Fi 8 adds dRU and UEQM-specific analysis burdens.[1][2][15][24][25]
| Area | Impact on required Signal Generator / Signal Analyzer capability |
|---|---|
| Bandwidth | Wi‑Fi 7 key throughput elements include 320 MHz channel bandwidth, and Wi‑Fi 8 is described as retaining Wi‑Fi 7 core PHY parameters including channel bandwidths up to 320 MHz.[2][24] Therefore the analyzer and generator need WLAN 320 MHz-class capability; examples in the passages include CMX500 WLAN 802.11be analyzer performance at 320 MHz and CMP180 WLAN 802.11be analyzer/generator performance at 320 MHz.[40][45] A 480 MHz WLAN waveform is only described as a potential Wi‑Fi 8 candidate / discussion item, not a formal Wi‑Fi 8 channel bandwidth, but it implies that future-proof test setups may need 500 MHz-class waveform verification capability; CMP180 is described as supporting bandwidths up to 500 MHz and demonstrating 480 MHz waveform loopback verification.[4][5][8] |
| Modulation / EVM | Wi‑Fi 7 includes 4096QAM, and Wi‑Fi 8 retains 4096QAM as a core PHY parameter.[2][24] This increases the need for low residual EVM in both analysis and generation; cited WLAN analyzer examples include CMX500 802.11be EVM of –49 dB measured at 160 MHz and –47 dB measured at 320 MHz, and CMP180 802.11be analyzer EVM of –46 dB measured at 320 MHz or –48 dB with CMP-KB805, while CMP180 802.11be generator EVM is listed as < –43 dB at 320 MHz.[40][45] |
| MIMO / multi-link | Wi‑Fi 7 lists up to 16 spatial streams and MLO as key throughput components, and MLO is also retained in Wi‑Fi 8.[2][24] Wi‑Fi 7 OTA development needs measurements of antennas and RF transmitter/receiver characteristics under real-world signaling conditions, and because MLO is a key Wi‑Fi 7 feature, a test environment with multiple RF chains is important.[25] CMX500 WLAN options include 802.11bn support and True MIMO 2x2 for 802.11n/ac/ax/be/bn signals, while CMP180 has WLAN true MIMO 2x2/4x4 and 5x5/6x6 measurement options listed.[40][47] |
| Wi‑Fi 8 dRU / UEQM analysis | Wi‑Fi 8 introduces / emphasizes dRU and UEQM: dRU is used to overcome PSD limits, and dRU measurements verify uplink transmit-power boost and connection-reliability improvement.[1][15] UEQM allows each MIMO link to use a different modulation scheme in difficult reception scenarios, and UEQM analysis evaluates whether the device adapts modulation correctly according to specified MCS combinations.[1][15] This means the analyzer must not only demodulate a packet, but also analyze per-link / per-MCS adaptation behavior for Wi‑Fi 8 signaling tests.[15] |
| Spectrum / emissions | Spectrum measurement remains necessary because unwanted-emissions items include occupied bandwidth, ACLR, operating-band unwanted emissions / SEM, transmitter spurious emissions, and transmitter intermodulation, with transmitter intermodulation noting that an additional signal generator is required.[68] CMX500 spectrum analysis options include frequency sweep power-vs-frequency, zero-span power-vs-time, RBW 100 Hz to 10 MHz, VBW 10 Hz to 10 MHz, and FFT spectrum analyzer spans up to 500 MHz with CMX-B600B broadband mode or 1 GHz with CMX-B500A IF unit only.[38][39] |
| Signaling vs non-signaling / OTA | Wi‑Fi 8 RF signaling tests are described as CMX500 signaling-mode tests for prototype Wi‑Fi 8 / IEEE 802.11bn WLAN device PHY features.[18][23] Wi‑Fi 7 OTA MIMO stress testing is described as over-the-air, signaling-mode, realistic multipath testing of antenna, RF transmitter/receiver, and multi-antenna performance for IEEE 802.11be stations and access points.[27][28] |
【推論】For Wi‑Fi 7/8, a practical signal analyzer/generator target should be at least 320 MHz WLAN bandwidth with EVM headroom suitable for 4096QAM, because Wi‑Fi 7 and Wi‑Fi 8 cite 320 MHz and 4096QAM, and instrument examples specify 320 MHz WLAN EVM performance.[2][24][40][45]
【推論】If preparing for discussed Wi‑Fi 8 extensions rather than only cited retained parameters, 500 MHz-class generation/analysis becomes relevant because 480 MHz is described as a potential candidate waveform and CMP180’s 500 MHz capability is tied to that loopback demonstration.[4][5][48][52]
【推論】Because MLO, spatial streams, dRU, and UEQM all involve multiple links, RF chains, resource allocations, or per-link modulation behavior, Wi‑Fi 7/8 testing increasingly needs multi-channel/MIMO signaling analysis rather than only single-link SISO RF measurements.[1][15][24][25][40][47]

answer.question: How do changes in Wi-Fi 7/8 technology affect the measurement capability required from Signal Generator / Signal Analyzer? Include impacts on bandwidth, modulation/EVM, MIMO/multi-link, spectrum/emissions, and signal generation/analyzer requirements.

passages.text:
Wi-Fi 8 › 新增 / 強調的 PHY 與 MAC layer technologies
[[Rohde & Schwarz and Broadcom showcase first Wi-Fi 8 RF signaling tests, paving way for next-gen connectivity]] 舉例列出：

- [[distributed resource units]]（dRU）：用於 overcome power spectral density（PSD）limits；dRU measurements 可驗證 uplink transmit power boost 與 connection reliability improvement。
- [[unequal modulation]]（UEQM）：在 difficult reception scenarios 中允許 each [[MIMO]] link 使用 different modulation scheme；UEQM analysis 可評估 device 是否依 specified MCS combinations 正確 adapt modulation。

Wi-Fi 8 › 延續自 Wi-Fi 7 的 core PHY parameters
依 [[Rohde & Schwarz and Broadcom showcase first Wi-Fi 8 RF signaling tests, paving way for next-gen connectivity]]，[[Wi-Fi 8]] 保留下列 [[Wi-Fi 7]] core physical layer parameters：

| 項目 | 來源說法 |
|---|---|
| supported frequencies | up to 7.125 GHz |
| channel bandwidth | up to 320 MHz |
| modulation | 4096QAM |
| multi-link | [[MLO]] |

以上是 PR 中對 Wi-Fi 8 的簡述，不等同於完整 IEEE 802.11bn normative specification。

Wi-Fi 8 › 使用限制
- 本頁目前由 [[Rohde & Schwarz and Broadcom showcase first Wi-Fi 8 RF signaling tests, paving way for next-gen connectivity]]、[[Rohde & Schwarz presents its Wi-Fi 7 multi-channel single-box test solutions for R&D and production at MWC 2024]] 與 [[WiFi8]] 支撐。
- [[WiFi8]] 是 OneNote link hub，不是文章正文、datasheet、configuration guide、IEEE standard text 或 certification document。
- PR / demonstration statement 不等同於 IEEE standard text、datasheet、configuration guide 或 certification document。
- 來源未標示 [[IEEE 802.11bn]] draft version、standard version、final ratification date 或 IEEE document number。
- 來源未列出完整 [[Wi-Fi 8]] PHY / MAC feature set、band plan、regulatory conditions、test requirements 或 interoperability criteria。
- 480 MHz waveform 僅能記為 MWC 2024 PR 中的 potential candidate，不可寫成 Wi-Fi 8 正式規格。
- 320 MHz channel bandwidth 僅能記為較晚 R&S / Broadcom PR 對 retained core PHY parameter 的說法，不可替代 IEEE 802.11bn 正式文件。
- 不可從 [[WiFi8]] 的連結標題推論 [[Broadcom]]、[[MediaTek]]、[[ASUS]] 或 [[Filogic 8000]] 的產品規格、上市時間、供應關係或認證狀態。

Wi-Fi 8 › 480 MHz waveform candidate 說法
[[Rohde & Schwarz presents its Wi-Fi 7 multi-channel single-box test solutions for R&D and production at MWC 2024]] 稱：

- [[R&S CMP180]] supports bandwidths up to 500 MHz。
- [[R&S CMP180]] will demonstrate its ability to verify a [[WLAN]] waveform with **480 MHz bandwidth** in loopback mode。
- 該 480 MHz waveform 被稱為 potential waveform candidate for the yet-to-be-defined [[Wi-Fi 8]] / [[IEEE 802.11bn]] standard。

此說法目前只能作為 MWC 2024 PR 的 candidate / discussion 記錄；不得推論 480 MHz 已成為 [[IEEE 802.11bn]] 標準通道頻寬。

Wi-Fi 8 › 來源中的技術定位
依 [[Rohde & Schwarz and Broadcom showcase first Wi-Fi 8 RF signaling tests, paving way for next-gen connectivity]]：

- [[IEEE 802.11bn]] amendment introduces advancements focused on consistent, high-quality connectivity across dense environments。
- 目標應用包含 growing number of connected devices、VR/AR、8K streaming、industrial IoT。
- [[Wi-Fi 8]] builds upon [[Wi-Fi 7]] foundation。
- 來源明示 final IEEE standard ratification 尚未完成；[[Rohde & Schwarz]] 的測試是在 ratification 前展示。

依 [[Rohde & Schwarz presents its Wi-Fi 7 multi-channel single-box test solutions for R&D and production at MWC 2024]]：

- [[Wi-Fi 8]] / [[IEEE 802.11bn]] 在 MWC 2024 語境下仍是 yet-to-be-defined standard。
- 來源稱 even wider channel bandwidths are in discussion。
- [[R&S CMP180]] 將展示 **480 MHz bandwidth** 的 [[WLAN]] waveform loopback mode verification，並稱該 waveform 是 [[Wi-Fi 8]] potential waveform candidate。

Wi-Fi 8
[[Wi-Fi 8]] 是 [[Rohde & Schwarz and Broadcom showcase first Wi-Fi 8 RF signaling tests, paving way for next-gen connectivity]] 中對 [[IEEE 802.11bn]] amendment 的市場 / 技術稱呼；該來源描述其重點從提高 throughput 轉向 ultra-high reliability（[[UHR]]）connectivity performance。較早的 [[Rohde & Schwarz presents its Wi-Fi 7 multi-channel single-box test solutions for R&D and production at MWC 2024]] 則把 [[IEEE 802.11bn]] 稱為 yet-to-be-defined，並提到 wider channel bandwidths are in discussion 與 480 MHz WLAN waveform potential candidate。

⚠️ [[Rohde & Schwarz presents its Wi-Fi 7 multi-channel single-box test solutions for R&D and production at MWC 2024]]（MWC 2024；發布日期來源未標示）說 [[Wi-Fi 8]] / [[IEEE 802.11bn]] 尚未定義，且 even wider channel bandwidths are in discussion，並稱 480 MHz [[WLAN]] waveform 是 potential waveform candidate，但既有頁面 [[Wi-Fi 8]] 說依 [[Rohde & Schwarz and Broadcom showcase first Wi-Fi 8 RF signaling tests, paving way for next-gen connectivity]] Wi‑Fi 8 保留 up to 320 MHz channel bandwidth。判斷：前者是較早期 discussion / candidate，後者是較晚 PR 的 implemented signaling-test description；先並列，不把 480 MHz 寫成 Wi‑Fi 8 正式規格。

Wi-Fi 8 RF signaling tests › Wi-Fi 8 測試重點

| 測試 / feature | 來源說法 |
|---|---|
| [[distributed resource units]] / dRU measurements | 用於驗證 device boosting uplink transmit power 與 improving connection reliability 的 effectiveness；來源提到 dRU 可 overcome PSD limits。 |
| [[unequal modulation]] / UEQM analysis | 在 difficult reception scenarios 中允許 each MIMO link 使用不同 modulation scheme；測試可評估 device 是否以 specified MCS combinations 正確 adapt modulation。 |
| comprehensive signaling mode tests | 來源稱可 cover a broad range of Wi‑Fi 8 features 並執行 in-depth analysis of performance characteristics。 |

- [[Wi-Fi 7 OTA MIMO stress testing]] 目前由 Bluetest / EMITE OTA chamber PR 支撐，聚焦 [[Wi-Fi 7]] / [[IEEE 802.11be]] over-the-air chamber workflow。
- [[Wi-Fi 8 RF signaling tests]] 目前由 [[Rohde & Schwarz]] / [[Broadcom]] PR 支撐，聚焦 [[R&S CMX500]] signaling mode、[[Wi-Fi 8]] PHY features 與 prototype Broadcom WLAN device。

Wi-Fi 8 RF signaling tests

Wi-Fi 7 OTA MIMO stress testing › Wi-Fi 7 技術背景
[[Bluetest and Rohde & Schwarz collaborate to offer over-the-air testing of next-generation WLAN devices]] 列出的 [[Wi-Fi 7]] / [[IEEE 802.11be]] throughput-related components 包含：

| 技術項目 | 來源說法 |
|---|---|
| 320 MHz channel bandwidth | key component facilitating higher throughput |
| up to 16 spatial streams | key component facilitating higher throughput |
| 4096 QAM modulation | key component facilitating higher throughput |
| [[MLO]] | key component；also key feature making multiple RF chains important |

[[Bluetest reverberation test solutions now support 4G, 5G NR, and WLAN over-the-air tests with Rohde & Schwarz CMX500 OBT]] 提供 solution-level update：[[Bluetest]] earlier integrated WLAN testing capabilities 現在支援 [[Wi-Fi 7]] bandwidth up to **320 MHz**。

[[EMITE and Rohde & Schwarz join forces to support OTA measurements on Wi-Fi 7 and 5G RedCap]] 則以背景段落描述 [[IEEE 802.11be]] / [[Wi-Fi 7]] 是 next generation Wi-Fi technology，面向 extremely high data throughput、tens of gigabits per second、low latency、ultra-high-definition video streaming、virtual reality 與 augmented reality applications。

以上皆為來源對 Wi-Fi 7 與整合測試能力的敘述，不等同於 [[R&S CMX500]]、[[R&S CMX500 OBT]]、[[Bluetest Flow]]、[[Bluetest]] RTS 或 [[EMITE]] chambers 對所有 feature combination 的完整規格保證。

Wi-Fi 7 OTA MIMO stress testing › 為什麼需要 OTA 與 multiple RF chains
[[Bluetest and Rohde & Schwarz collaborate to offer over-the-air testing of next-generation WLAN devices]] 指出，在 WLAN devices development 期間，需要在 real-world conditions in signaling mode 下量測 antennas 以及 RF transmitter / receiver characteristics。由於 [[MLO]] 是 [[Wi-Fi 7]] key feature，提供 multiple RF chains 的 test environment 很關鍵。

同一來源同時將 [[R&S CMX500]] 描述為 multi-technology multi-channel signaling tester；其 flexibility、support for multiple radio technologies 與 embedded IP test capabilities 使其可用於 broad range of Wi-Fi 7-specific tests。

[[Bluetest reverberation test solutions now support 4G, 5G NR, and WLAN over-the-air tests with Rohde & Schwarz CMX500 OBT]] 進一步把 Wi-Fi 7 OTA 測試放入更廣的 [[4G 5G NR WLAN OTA MIMO stress testing]] 情境：同一 [[R&S CMX500 OBT]] / [[Bluetest]] RTS workflow 同時涵蓋 WiFi、[[LTE]]、5G SA / NSA 的 radio and antenna performance validation。

[[EMITE and Rohde & Schwarz join forces to support OTA measurements on Wi-Fi 7 and 5G RedCap]] 沒有使用 MIMO stress testing 一詞，也沒有提供 RF chains、spatial streams 或 chamber reflection model；它的貢獻是確認另一個 OTA chamber vendor [[EMITE]] 也將 [[R&S CMX500]] 整合到 [[Wi-Fi 7]] OTA measurement solution 中。

Wi-Fi 7 OTA MIMO stress testing › 可追溯範圍與限制
- 本頁目前由 [[Bluetest and Rohde & Schwarz collaborate to offer over-the-air testing of next-generation WLAN devices]]、[[Bluetest reverberation test solutions now support 4G, 5G NR, and WLAN over-the-air tests with Rohde & Schwarz CMX500 OBT]] 與 [[EMITE and Rohde & Schwarz join forces to support OTA measurements on Wi-Fi 7 and 5G RedCap]] 支撐。
- 本頁不推論 [[R&S CMX500]] 或 [[R&S CMX500 OBT]] 實際支援的 RF chains 數量、spatial streams 數量、MLO link combination、software option code 或 hardware configuration。
- 本頁不推論 [[Bluetest RTS65]]、其他 Bluetest RTS chambers 或 [[EMITE]] OTA chambers 的完整規格、measurement uncertainty、校準流程或 certification applicability。
- 本頁不把新聞稿中的 solution positioning 視為 conformance test coverage 或正式規格。
- [[Bluetest reverberation test solutions now support 4G, 5G NR, and WLAN over-the-air tests with Rohde & Schwarz CMX500 OBT]] 標示 [[Bluetest Flow]] v1.18，但未提供 release date、release notes、license requirement 或相容性矩陣。
- [[EMITE and Rohde & Schwarz join forces to support OTA measurements on Wi-Fi 7 and 5G RedCap]] 使用 full compliance with [[IEEE 802.11be]] 的語句，但未展開 compliance 的測試項目、標準版本、認證機構或是否等同正式 conformance / certification testing。

Wi-Fi 7 OTA MIMO stress testing
[[Wi-Fi 7 OTA MIMO stress testing]] 是在 over-the-air、signaling mode 與 realistic multipath RF conditions 下，對 [[IEEE 802.11be]] stations 與 access points 的 antenna、RF transmitter / receiver 與 multi-antenna performance 進行壓力測試的測試情境。新匯入的 [[EMITE and Rohde & Schwarz join forces to support OTA measurements on Wi-Fi 7 and 5G RedCap]] 補充另一個 partner integration 視角：[[EMITE]] OTA chambers 可整合 [[R&S CMX500]] 最新測試能力，用於 [[Wi-Fi 7]] 與 [[5G RedCap]] device performance assessment。

Wi-Fi 7 OTA MIMO stress testing › 來源中的測試架構
[[Bluetest and Rohde & Schwarz collaborate to offer over-the-air testing of next-generation WLAN devices]]（來源未標示發布日期；raw created 2026-09-11）描述的架構為：

- [[R&S CMX500]] one-box signaling tester 提供 integrated [[Wi-Fi 7]] test functionality。
- [[Bluetest Flow]] control software / integrated test environment 整合 [[R&S CMX500]] 的 [[Wi-Fi 7]] test functionality。
- [[Bluetest]] reverberation test systems（RTS），例如 [[Bluetest RTS65]]，提供 reverberation chamber OTA environment。
- 測試對象為 [[IEEE 802.11be]] stations 與 access points。
- 測試目標為 MIMO stress testing under realistic conditions。

[[Bluetest reverberation test solutions now support 4G, 5G NR, and WLAN over-the-air tests with Rohde & Schwarz CMX500 OBT]]（來源未標示發布日期；raw created 2026-09-11）補充：

- [[Bluetest]] expanded its earlier integrated testing capabilities for [[WLAN]] stations and access points（[[IEEE 802.11]] a/b/g/n/ac/ax/be）。
- [[Wi-Fi 7]] 現在支援 bandwidth up to **320 MHz**。
- 此能力與 [[R&S CMX500 OBT]]、[[Bluetest Flow]] v1.18 與 [[Bluetest]] RTS 組成 single tester and reverberation test system 的 integrated path。

[[EMITE and Rohde & Schwarz join forces to support OTA measurements on Wi-Fi 7 and 5G RedCap]]（來源未標示發布日期；raw created 2026-09-11）補充：

- [[EMITE]] over-the-air chambers 可 combined with the latest sophisticated testing features of [[R&S CMX500]]。
- 整合 enables support of [[LTE]]、[[NR FR1]]、[[NR FR2]]、full compliance with [[IEEE 802.11be]] and [[5G RedCap]]。
- [[R&S CMX500]] 被描述為支援 non-cellular technologies including latest [[Wi-Fi 7]]，all in a single instrument。
- [[EMITE]] customers obtain a comprehensive environment for accurately assessing performance of [[Wi-Fi 7]] as well as [[5G RedCap]] devices。

R&S CMX500 › NR FR1
依 [[CMX500_Features_CSW9-20-0_en_32]]，R&S CMX-KM600 是 frequency range 1 對 NR uplink signals 執行任何 TX tests 的必要 option。NR FR1 uplink measurements 包含 multi-evaluation、PRACH、SRS、TPC measurement。Multi-evaluation 支援 NR channel bandwidth **3 MHz 到 100 MHz**，可分析 FDD 與 TDD signals、NR standalone signals 與 intraband contiguous EN-DC signals。

依 [[CMX500_specs_en_5216-4127-22_v1100]]，R&S CMX-KM600 option 的 5G NR analyzer 條件為 FR1、SCS 30 kHz、16QAM、temperature range +15 °C to +35 °C；input level –25 dBm to –10 dBm RMS、bandwidth 100 MHz 時 EVM **< 0.5 %**。Frequency measurement uncertainty：**< 20 Hz + drift of timebase**；相對於同一台 CMX500 device 的 downlink signal 進行 frequency error measurements 時，uncertainty 符合 [[3GPP TS 38.521-1]] V18.5.0。

R&S CMX-KW601 option 的 5G NR generator 條件：5G NR PDSCH、full allocation、SCS 30 kHz / 60 kHz、modulation 64QAM、PAR 11.8 dB、temperature +15 °C to +35 °C；ports RF Com 1、RF Com 2、RF Out 1 to RF Out 4；output level –5 dBm、bandwidth 100 MHz 時 EVM **< 0.5 %**。

R&S CMX500 › ARB 與 FFT spectrum analyzer
依 [[CMX500_specs_en_5216-4127-22_v1100]]：

- Modulation source：arbitrary waveform generator（ARB）。
- ARB 先決條件：[[R&S CMX-B500A]] 或 [[R&S CMX-B600B]]，以及 [[R&S CMX-KW601]] options。
- ARB with [[R&S CMX-B600B]]：memory size **16 Gbyte**；I/Q word length **32 bit**；marker word length **8 bit**；sample length **up to 1.5 Gsample**；maximum sample rate **1.25 GHz**；maximum possible RF bandwidth **1 GHz**，取決於 arbitrary waveform file。
- FFT spectrum analyzer frequency span：10 MHz、20 MHz、40 MHz、160 MHz、250 MHz；with [[R&S CMX-B600B]] RF unit in broadband mode **500 MHz**；[[R&S CMX-B500A]] IF unit only **1 GHz**。
- FFT length：1k、2k、4k、8k、16k；detector：peak、RMS。

R&S CMX500 › Spectrum analysis
依 [[CMX500_Features_CSW9-20-0_en_32]]，R&S CMX-KM140 提供 spectrum analysis options，包含 frequency sweep measurement（power vs frequency）與 zero span measurement（power vs time）。General settings 包含 external attenuation **-50 dB 至 90 dB**、sweep count **1 至 100**、sweep points **101 至 100001**；frequency sweep RBW **100 Hz 至 10 MHz**，VBW **10 Hz 至 10 MHz**。

[[CMX500_specs_en_5216-4127-22_v1100]] 另提供 FFT spectrum analyzer span 與 FFT length，詳見 ARB 與 FFT spectrum analyzer 章節。

R&S CMX500 › WLAN
依 [[CMX500_Features_CSW9-20-0_en_32]]，R&S CMX-KM350 為 WLAN measurements necessary option，支援 802.11a/b/g/n/ac。R&S CMX-KM351 支援 802.11ax 且需要 R&S CMX-KM350；R&S CMX-KM352 支援 802.11be 且需要 R&S CMX-KM351；R&S CMX-KM353 支援 802.11bn 且需要 R&S CMX-KM352 與 R&S CMX-KM351。R&S CMX-KM360 提供 True MIMO measurements，2x2 MIMO 適用於 802.11n、802.11ac、802.11ax、802.11be、802.11bn signals。

依 [[CMX500_specs_en_5216-4127-22_v1100]] 的 analyzer 摘錄：

- R&S CMX-KM350 WLAN IEEE 802.11a/b/g/n/ac analyzer：input level –25 dBm to –10 dBm RMS；bandwidth 20/22/40/160 MHz；EVM **< –46 dB**，條件包含 channel estimation payload、burst length > 16 symbols、average > 20 packets、+15 °C to +35 °C。
- R&S CMX-KM351 WLAN IEEE 802.11ax analyzer：input level –25 dBm to –10 dBm RMS；bandwidth 160 MHz；EVM **< –46 dB**。
- R&S CMX-KM352 WLAN IEEE 802.11be analyzer：input level –25 dBm to –10 dBm RMS；bandwidth 160 MHz：**–49 dB meas.**；bandwidth 320 MHz：**–47 dB meas.**。

| 項目 | 規格 |
|---|---|
| Connector | 3 × IF In，port 1、port 2、port 3，SMA |
| Frequency range | 4 GHz to 20 GHz，inclusive modulation bandwidth |

Displayed average noise level 條件：+15 °C to +35 °C、ENP < –35 dBm。4 GHz to 16 GHz，except 9.0 GHz to 12.5 GHz：**< –152 dBm (1 Hz)**；16 GHz to 17 GHz：**< –150 dBm (1 Hz)**。

IF analyzer EVM 條件：5G NR PUSCH、channel bandwidth 100 MHz、full allocation、SCS 60 kHz / 120 kHz、modulation 64QAM、PAR 11.8 dB、port 1、+15 °C to +35 °C、within ±5 °C from last I/Q alignment procedure temperature。EVM：4 GHz to 6 GHz、P –38 dBm to 0 dBm RMS：**< –38 dB meas.**；6 GHz to 14 GHz、P –32 dBm to 0 dBm RMS：**< –38 dB meas.**；14 GHz to 17 GHz：**< –38 dB meas.**。

R&S CMX500 › R&S CMX-B200A accelerator unit
依 [[CMX500_specs_en_5216-4127-22_v1100]]，[[R&S CMX-B200A]] 提供 accelerated digital signal processing capabilities，並包含 two high-speed digital I/Q interfaces：

- RF generator signal is split and forwarded to 8 output ports each。
- every output can be switched off separately。
- collective output level setting for connectors RF 1.1 to RF 1.8 and RF 2.1 to RF 2.8。
- frequency-dependent attenuation（FDA）table for user-specific corrections，分別對 RF 1.1 to RF 1.8 與 RF 2.1 to RF 2.8。

R&S SMW200A › 產品定位與架構

- [[R&S SMW200A]] 可從 single-path vector signal generator 擴充到 multichannel [[MIMO]] receiver tester。
- 支援最多 `8` 個 signal sources 與最多 `64` 個 fading channels。
- 可連接 [[R&S SGT100A]] signal generator modules，提供最多 `8` 條 RF paths。
- 最多可在 `2` 個 internal baseband modules 上配置 `8` 個 baseband generators，具 real-time coder 與 ARB。
- 單機可配置最多兩個 internal RF paths：RF path A 為 mandatory，RF path B 為 optional second RF path。
- Baseband section 分成 standard baseband section 與 wideband baseband section；standard baseband 最高 `160 MHz` RF modulation bandwidth，wideband baseband 最高 `2 GHz` RF modulation bandwidth。
- 可選 integrated fading section，channel emulation bandwidth 最高 `800 MHz`；最多可安裝 `4` 個 fading modules，提供最多 `64` 個 logical faders。
- 單一儀器可實作 MIMO fading scenarios：`2x2`、`3x3`、`4x4`、`8x4`、`4x8`、`2x4x4`。
- Path-specific、baseband-specific 與 fading/MIMO software options 採 floating license concept；若同一 feature 需同時在兩個 paths 或兩個 baseband generators 使用，通常需安裝兩份對應 option。

With tens of gigabits of data per second and low latency, it meets the growing demand for ultra-high-definition video streaming, virtual reality and augmented reality applications. Key elements to achieve higher throughput are an increased channel bandwidth of 320 MHz, up to 16 spatial streams and 4096 QAM modulation. Short answer: Wi‑Fi 7/8 pushes signal generator / analyzer capability from ordinary WLAN testing toward wider instantaneous bandwidth, lower EVM floors for 4096QAM, multi-RF-chain / MIMO / MLO operation, and deeper spectrum/emissions and signaling analysis, while Wi‑Fi 8 adds dRU and UEQM-specific analysis burdens.[1][2][15][24][25]
| Area | Impact on required Signal Generator / Signal Analyzer capability |
|---|---|
| Bandwidth | Wi‑Fi 7 key throughput elements include 320 MHz channel bandwidth, and Wi‑Fi 8 is described as retaining Wi‑Fi 7 core PHY parameters including channel bandwidths up to 320 MHz.[2][24] Therefore the analyzer and generator need WLAN 320 MHz-class capability; examples in the passages include CMX500 WLAN 802.11be analyzer performance at 320 MHz and CMP180 WLAN 802.11be analyzer/generator performance at 320 MHz.[40][45] A 480 MHz WLAN waveform is only described as a potential Wi‑Fi 8 candidate / discussion item, not a formal Wi‑Fi 8 channel bandwidth, but it implies that future-proof test setups may need 500 MHz-class waveform verification capability; CMP180 is described as supporting bandwidths up to 500 MHz and demonstrating 480 MHz waveform loopback verification.[4][5][8] |
| Modulation / EVM | Wi‑Fi 7 includes 4096QAM, and Wi‑Fi 8 retains 4096QAM as a core PHY parameter.[2][24] This increases the need for low residual EVM in both analysis and generation; cited WLAN analyzer examples include CMX500 802.11be EVM of –49 dB measured at 160 MHz and –47 dB measured at 320 MHz, and CMP180 802.11be analyzer EVM of –46 dB measured at 320 MHz or –48 dB with CMP-KB805, while CMP180 802.11be generator EVM is listed as < –43 dB at 320 MHz.[40][45] |
| MIMO / multi-link | Wi‑Fi 7 lists up to 16 spatial streams and MLO as key throughput components, and MLO is also retained in Wi‑Fi 8.[2][24] Wi‑Fi 7 OTA development needs measurements of antennas and RF transmitter/receiver characteristics under real-world signaling conditions, and because MLO is a key Wi‑Fi 7 feature, a test environment with multiple RF chains is important.[25] CMX500 WLAN options include 802.11bn support and True MIMO 2x2 for 802.11n/ac/ax/be/bn signals, while CMP180 has WLAN true MIMO 2x2/4x4 and 5x5/6x6 measurement options listed.[40][47] |
| Wi‑Fi 8 dRU / UEQM analysis | Wi‑Fi 8 introduces / emphasizes dRU and UEQM: dRU is used to overcome PSD limits, and dRU measurements verify uplink transmit-power boost and connection-reliability improvement.[1][15] UEQM allows each MIMO link to use a different modulation scheme in difficult reception scenarios, and UEQM analysis evaluates whether the device adapts modulation correctly according to specified MCS combinations.[1][15] This means the analyzer must not only demodulate a packet, but also analyze per-link / per-MCS adaptation behavior for Wi‑Fi 8 signaling tests.[15] |
| Spectrum / emissions | Spectrum measurement remains necessary because unwanted-emissions items include occupied bandwidth, ACLR, operating-band unwanted emissions / SEM, transmitter spurious emissions, and transmitter intermodulation, with transmitter intermodulation noting that an additional signal generator is required.[68] CMX500 spectrum analysis options include frequency sweep power-vs-frequency, zero-span power-vs-time, RBW 100 Hz to 10 MHz, VBW 10 Hz to 10 MHz, and FFT spectrum analyzer spans up to 500 MHz with CMX-B600B broadband mode or 1 GHz with CMX-B500A IF unit only.[38][39] |
| Signaling vs non-signaling / OTA | Wi‑Fi 8 RF signaling tests are described as CMX500 signaling-mode tests for prototype Wi‑Fi 8 / IEEE 802.11bn WLAN device PHY features.[18][23] Wi‑Fi 7 OTA MIMO stress testing is described as over-the-air, signaling-mode, realistic multipath testing of antenna, RF transmitter/receiver, and multi-antenna performance for IEEE 802.11be stations and access points.[27][28] |
【推論】For Wi‑Fi 7/8, a practical signal analyzer/generator target should be at least 320 MHz WLAN bandwidth with EVM headroom suitable for 4096QAM, because Wi‑Fi 7 and Wi‑Fi 8 cite 320 MHz and 4096QAM, and instrument examples specify 320 MHz WLAN EVM performance.[2][24][40][45]
【推論】If preparing for discussed Wi‑Fi 8 extensions rather than only cited retained parameters, 500 MHz-class generation/analysis becomes relevant because 480 MHz is described as a potential candidate waveform and CMP180’s 500 MHz capability is tied to that loopback demonstration.[4][5][48][52]
【推論】Because MLO, spatial streams, dRU, and UEQM all involve multiple links, RF chains, resource allocations, or per-link modulation behavior, Wi‑Fi 7/8 testing increasingly needs multi-channel/MIMO signaling analysis rather than only single-link SISO RF measurements.[1][15][24][25][40][47]

以上是 PR 中對 Wi-Fi 8 的簡述，不等同於完整 IEEE 802.11bn normative specification。

Wi-Fi 8 › 480 MHz waveform candidate 說法
[[Rohde & Schwarz presents its Wi-Fi 7 multi-channel single-box test solutions for R&D and production at MWC 2024]] 稱：

- [[R&S CMP180]] supports bandwidths up to 500 MHz。
- [[R&S CMP180]] will demonstrate its ability to verify a [[WLAN]] waveform with **480 MHz bandwidth** in loopback mode。
- 該 480 MHz waveform 被稱為 potential waveform candidate for the yet-to-be-defined [[Wi-Fi 8]] / [[IEEE 802.11bn]] standard。

此說法目前只能作為 MWC 2024 PR 的 candidate / discussion 記錄；不得推論 480 MHz 已成為 [[IEEE 802.11bn]] 標準通道頻寬。

Wi-Fi 8 › 來源中的技術定位
依 [[Rohde & Schwarz and Broadcom showcase first Wi-Fi 8 RF signaling tests, paving way for next-gen connectivity]]：

- [[IEEE 802.11bn]] amendment introduces advancements focused on consistent, high-quality connectivity across dense environments。
- 目標應用包含 growing number of connected devices、VR/AR、8K streaming、industrial IoT。
- [[Wi-Fi 8]] builds upon [[Wi-Fi 7]] foundation。
- 來源明示 final IEEE standard ratification 尚未完成；[[Rohde & Schwarz]] 的測試是在 ratification 前展示。

依 [[Rohde & Schwarz presents its Wi-Fi 7 multi-channel single-box test solutions for R&D and production at MWC 2024]]：

- [[Wi-Fi 8]] / [[IEEE 802.11bn]] 在 MWC 2024 語境下仍是 yet-to-be-defined standard。
- 來源稱 even wider channel bandwidths are in discussion。
- [[R&S CMP180]] 將展示 **480 MHz bandwidth** 的 [[WLAN]] waveform loopback mode verification，並稱該 waveform 是 [[Wi-Fi 8]] potential waveform candidate。

Wi-Fi 8 › 與 R&S CMX500 / CMP180 的關係
[[Rohde & Schwarz and Broadcom showcase first Wi-Fi 8 RF signaling tests, paving way for next-gen connectivity]] 稱 [[R&S CMX500]] 已加入 newly added [[Wi-Fi 8]] / [[IEEE 802.11bn]] testing capabilities，並將在 [[MWC Barcelona 2026]] 驗證 [[Broadcom]] prototype [[Wi-Fi 8]] device。

[[Rohde & Schwarz presents its Wi-Fi 7 multi-channel single-box test solutions for R&D and production at MWC 2024]] 則在較早 MWC 2024 語境中，把 [[R&S CMP180]] 的 480 MHz [[WLAN]] waveform loopback demonstration 描述為 potential [[Wi-Fi 8]] candidate，並將 [[R&S CMP180]] 定位為 future-proof R&D / production tester。

這兩種說法層次不同：[[R&S CMX500]] 來源是 Wi‑Fi 8 RF signaling tests / prototype device demonstration；[[R&S CMP180]] 來源是 480 MHz waveform loopback / candidate demonstration。

Wi-Fi 8 RF signaling tests › Wi-Fi 8 測試重點
來源描述 [[IEEE 802.11bn]] / [[Wi-Fi 8]] 的重點從 sheer speed 轉向 [[UHR]] performance。相關測試重點包括：

| 測試 / feature | 來源說法 |
|---|---|
| [[distributed resource units]] / dRU measurements | 用於驗證 device boosting uplink transmit power 與 improving connection reliability 的 effectiveness；來源提到 dRU 可 overcome PSD limits。 |
| [[unequal modulation]] / UEQM analysis | 在 difficult reception scenarios 中允許 each MIMO link 使用不同 modulation scheme；測試可評估 device 是否以 specified MCS combinations 正確 adapt modulation。 |
| comprehensive signaling mode tests | 來源稱可 cover a broad range of Wi‑Fi 8 features 並執行 in-depth analysis of performance characteristics。 |

Wi-Fi 8 RF signaling tests
[[Wi-Fi 8 RF signaling tests]] 是 [[Rohde & Schwarz and Broadcom showcase first Wi-Fi 8 RF signaling tests, paving way for next-gen connectivity]] 中描述的 [[R&S CMX500]] signaling mode 測試能力，用於驗證 prototype [[Wi-Fi 8]] / [[IEEE 802.11bn]] WLAN device 的 physical layer features。

Rohde & Schwarz and Broadcom showcase first Wi-Fi 8 RF signaling tests, paving way for next-gen connectivity
這是 [[Rohde & Schwarz]] 新聞稿，說明 [[R&S CMX500]] one-box signaling tester 已加入首批 [[Wi-Fi 8]] / [[IEEE 802.11bn]] RF signaling mode 測試能力，並將在 [[MWC Barcelona 2026]] 與 [[Broadcom]] prototype next-generation WLAN device 共同展示。

Wi-Fi 7 OTA MIMO stress testing › Wi-Fi 7 技術背景
[[Bluetest and Rohde & Schwarz collaborate to offer over-the-air testing of next-generation WLAN devices]] 列出的 [[Wi-Fi 7]] / [[IEEE 802.11be]] throughput-related components 包含：

| 技術項目 | 來源說法 |
|---|---|
| 320 MHz channel bandwidth | key component facilitating higher throughput |
| up to 16 spatial streams | key component facilitating higher throughput |
| 4096 QAM modulation | key component facilitating higher throughput |
| [[MLO]] | key component；also key feature making multiple RF chains important |

[[Bluetest reverberation test solutions now support 4G, 5G NR, and WLAN over-the-air tests with Rohde & Schwarz CMX500 OBT]] 提供 solution-level update：[[Bluetest]] earlier integrated WLAN testing capabilities 現在支援 [[Wi-Fi 7]] bandwidth up to **320 MHz**。

[[EMITE and Rohde & Schwarz join forces to support OTA measurements on Wi-Fi 7 and 5G RedCap]] 則以背景段落描述 [[IEEE 802.11be]] / [[Wi-Fi 7]] 是 next generation Wi-Fi technology，面向 extremely high data throughput、tens of gigabits per second、low latency、ultra-high-definition video streaming、virtual reality 與 augmented reality applications。

以上皆為來源對 Wi-Fi 7 與整合測試能力的敘述，不等同於 [[R&S CMX500]]、[[R&S CMX500 OBT]]、[[Bluetest Flow]]、[[Bluetest]] RTS 或 [[EMITE]] chambers 對所有 feature combination 的完整規格保證。

Wi-Fi 7 OTA MIMO stress testing › 為什麼需要 OTA 與 multiple RF chains
[[Bluetest and Rohde & Schwarz collaborate to offer over-the-air testing of next-generation WLAN devices]] 指出，在 WLAN devices development 期間，需要在 real-world conditions in signaling mode 下量測 antennas 以及 RF transmitter / receiver characteristics。由於 [[MLO]] 是 [[Wi-Fi 7]] key feature，提供 multiple RF chains 的 test environment 很關鍵。

同一來源同時將 [[R&S CMX500]] 描述為 multi-technology multi-channel signaling tester；其 flexibility、support for multiple radio technologies 與 embedded IP test capabilities 使其可用於 broad range of Wi-Fi 7-specific tests。

[[Bluetest reverberation test solutions now support 4G, 5G NR, and WLAN over-the-air tests with Rohde & Schwarz CMX500 OBT]] 進一步把 Wi-Fi 7 OTA 測試放入更廣的 [[4G 5G NR WLAN OTA MIMO stress testing]] 情境：同一 [[R&S CMX500 OBT]] / [[Bluetest]] RTS workflow 同時涵蓋 WiFi、[[LTE]]、5G SA / NSA 的 radio and antenna performance validation。

[[EMITE and Rohde & Schwarz join forces to support OTA measurements on Wi-Fi 7 and 5G RedCap]] 沒有使用 MIMO stress testing 一詞，也沒有提供 RF chains、spatial streams 或 chamber reflection model；它的貢獻是確認另一個 OTA chamber vendor [[EMITE]] 也將 [[R&S CMX500]] 整合到 [[Wi-Fi 7]] OTA measurement solution 中。

Wi-Fi 7 OTA MIMO stress testing
[[Wi-Fi 7 OTA MIMO stress testing]] 是在 over-the-air、signaling mode 與 realistic multipath RF conditions 下，對 [[IEEE 802.11be]] stations 與 access points 的 antenna、RF transmitter / receiver 與 multi-antenna performance 進行壓力測試的測試情境。新匯入的 [[EMITE and Rohde & Schwarz join forces to support OTA measurements on Wi-Fi 7 and 5G RedCap]] 補充另一個 partner integration 視角：[[EMITE]] OTA chambers 可整合 [[R&S CMX500]] 最新測試能力，用於 [[Wi-Fi 7]] 與 [[5G RedCap]] device performance assessment。

Wi-Fi 7 OTA MIMO stress testing › 來源中的測試架構
[[Bluetest and Rohde & Schwarz collaborate to offer over-the-air testing of next-generation WLAN devices]]（來源未標示發布日期；raw created 2026-09-11）描述的架構為：

- [[R&S CMX500]] one-box signaling tester 提供 integrated [[Wi-Fi 7]] test functionality。
- [[Bluetest Flow]] control software / integrated test environment 整合 [[R&S CMX500]] 的 [[Wi-Fi 7]] test functionality。
- [[Bluetest]] reverberation test systems（RTS），例如 [[Bluetest RTS65]]，提供 reverberation chamber OTA environment。
- 測試對象為 [[IEEE 802.11be]] stations 與 access points。
- 測試目標為 MIMO stress testing under realistic conditions。

[[Bluetest reverberation test solutions now support 4G, 5G NR, and WLAN over-the-air tests with Rohde & Schwarz CMX500 OBT]]（來源未標示發布日期；raw created 2026-09-11）補充：

- [[Bluetest]] expanded its earlier integrated testing capabilities for [[WLAN]] stations and access points（[[IEEE 802.11]] a/b/g/n/ac/ax/be）。
- [[Wi-Fi 7]] 現在支援 bandwidth up to **320 MHz**。
- 此能力與 [[R&S CMX500 OBT]]、[[Bluetest Flow]] v1.18 與 [[Bluetest]] RTS 組成 single tester and reverberation test system 的 integrated path。

[[EMITE and Rohde & Schwarz join forces to support OTA measurements on Wi-Fi 7 and 5G RedCap]]（來源未標示發布日期；raw created 2026-09-11）補充：

- [[EMITE]] over-the-air chambers 可 combined with the latest sophisticated testing features of [[R&S CMX500]]。
- 整合 enables support of [[LTE]]、[[NR FR1]]、[[NR FR2]]、full compliance with [[IEEE 802.11be]] and [[5G RedCap]]。
- [[R&S CMX500]] 被描述為支援 non-cellular technologies including latest [[Wi-Fi 7]]，all in a single instrument。
- [[EMITE]] customers obtain a comprehensive environment for accurately assessing performance of [[Wi-Fi 7]] as well as [[5G RedCap]] devices。

R&S CMX500 › ARB 與 FFT spectrum analyzer
依 [[CMX500_specs_en_5216-4127-22_v1100]]：

- Modulation source：arbitrary waveform generator（ARB）。
- ARB 先決條件：[[R&S CMX-B500A]] 或 [[R&S CMX-B600B]]，以及 [[R&S CMX-KW601]] options。
- ARB with [[R&S CMX-B600B]]：memory size **16 Gbyte**；I/Q word length **32 bit**；marker word length **8 bit**；sample length **up to 1.5 Gsample**；maximum sample rate **1.25 GHz**；maximum possible RF bandwidth **1 GHz**，取決於 arbitrary waveform file。
- FFT spectrum analyzer frequency span：10 MHz、20 MHz、40 MHz、160 MHz、250 MHz；with [[R&S CMX-B600B]] RF unit in broadband mode **500 MHz**；[[R&S CMX-B500A]] IF unit only **1 GHz**。
- FFT length：1k、2k、4k、8k、16k；detector：peak、RMS。

R&S CMX500 › Spectrum analysis
依 [[CMX500_Features_CSW9-20-0_en_32]]，R&S CMX-KM140 提供 spectrum analysis options，包含 frequency sweep measurement（power vs frequency）與 zero span measurement（power vs time）。General settings 包含 external attenuation **-50 dB 至 90 dB**、sweep count **1 至 100**、sweep points **101 至 100001**；frequency sweep RBW **100 Hz 至 10 MHz**，VBW **10 Hz 至 10 MHz**。

[[CMX500_specs_en_5216-4127-22_v1100]] 另提供 FFT spectrum analyzer span 與 FFT length，詳見 ARB 與 FFT spectrum analyzer 章節。

R&S CMX500 › WLAN
依 [[CMX500_Features_CSW9-20-0_en_32]]，R&S CMX-KM350 為 WLAN measurements necessary option，支援 802.11a/b/g/n/ac。R&S CMX-KM351 支援 802.11ax 且需要 R&S CMX-KM350；R&S CMX-KM352 支援 802.11be 且需要 R&S CMX-KM351；R&S CMX-KM353 支援 802.11bn 且需要 R&S CMX-KM352 與 R&S CMX-KM351。R&S CMX-KM360 提供 True MIMO measurements，2x2 MIMO 適用於 802.11n、802.11ac、802.11ax、802.11be、802.11bn signals。

依 [[CMX500_specs_en_5216-4127-22_v1100]] 的 analyzer 摘錄：

- R&S CMX-KM350 WLAN IEEE 802.11a/b/g/n/ac analyzer：input level –25 dBm to –10 dBm RMS；bandwidth 20/22/40/160 MHz；EVM **< –46 dB**，條件包含 channel estimation payload、burst length > 16 symbols、average > 20 packets、+15 °C to +35 °C。
- R&S CMX-KM351 WLAN IEEE 802.11ax analyzer：input level –25 dBm to –10 dBm RMS；bandwidth 160 MHz；EVM **< –46 dB**。
- R&S CMX-KM352 WLAN IEEE 802.11be analyzer：input level –25 dBm to –10 dBm RMS；bandwidth 160 MHz：**–49 dB meas.**；bandwidth 320 MHz：**–47 dB meas.**。

R&S CMP180 › Selected measurement performance
依 [[CMP180 Specifications Version 08.00]]：

| R&S CMP-KW352 | WLAN IEEE 802.11be generator | 160 MHz < –45 dB；320 MHz < –43 dB |
